verses.text: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
He cuts off every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit. He prunes every branch that does bear fruit, so it can produce even more.
You’ve already been pruned clean because of the word I’ve spoken to you.
Stay in me, and I’ll stay in you. A branch can’t produce fruit on its own; it has to stay connected to the vine. Neither can you, unless you stay in me.
I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever stays in me, and I in them, produces much fruit. Apart from me, you can do nothing.
If anyone doesn’t stay in me, they’re thrown away like a branch and dry up. People gather those branches, throw them into the fire, and burn them.
If you stay in me and my words stay in you, ask for whatever you want, and it will be done for you.
“My Father is glorified when you produce lots of fruit and show that you’re my disciples.
Just as the Father has loved me, I have loved you. Stay in my love.
If you keep my commands, you’ll stay in my love, just as I’ve kept my Father’s commands and stay in his love.
I’ve told you these things so my joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
“This is my command: Love one another just as I have loved you.
No one has greater love than this: to give their life for their friends.
You are my friends if you do what I command you.
I no longer call you servants, because a servant doesn’t know what the master is doing. I’ve called you friends, because I’ve told you everything I heard from my Father.
You didn’t choose me; I chose you and appointed you to go and produce lasting fruit. Then the Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.
“I’m commanding you to love one another.
If the world hates you, remember it hated me first.
If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. But you don’t belong to the world. I chose you out of it, and that’s why the world hates you.
Remember what I told you: ‘A servant isn’t greater than the master.’ If they persecuted me, they’ll persecute you too. If they kept my word, they’ll keep yours too.
They’ll do all this to you because of my name, since they don’t know the one who sent me.
If I hadn’t come and spoken to them, they wouldn’t be guilty in this way. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
Whoever hates me also hates my Father.
If I hadn’t done among them works no one else has done, they wouldn’t be guilty in this way. But now they’ve seen the works and still hate both me and my Father.
This happened so the words written in their Law would be fulfilled: ‘They hated me without a reason.’
“When the Helper comes—the Spirit of truth, whom I’ll send to you from the Father—he will testify about me.
And you will testify too, because you’ve been with me from the beginning.
